what_it_does: Scientists often run data-intensive simulation workflows (like MuMMI ensemble climate work) on custom-built supercomputers but want to move them to cloud platforms for flexibility. Traditional HPC tools don't map well to cloud-native infrastructure. This paper redesigns an ensemble workflow to run natively on Kubernetes and compares two approaches: service-based orchestration (explicit data passing between jobs) versus event-driven (publish-subscribe style job triggering).
